mechanism: Selegiline may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of levonorgestrel, potentially increasing progestin levels and altering contraceptive efficacy; additional concern for serotonergic effects if levonorgestrel formulations contain other agents.
action: Monitor contraceptive efficacy and consider backup contraception; counsel patient on breakthrough bleeding risk and watch for serotonin syndrome symptoms if combined with other serotonergic agents.
